chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah narrated from his father, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from al-Hasan ibn Musa, from al-Husayn ibn Yahya, from al-Husayn ibn Mazid, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his ancestors, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said:
Wear your rings with Aqiq (cornelian), may Allah bless you, and you will be safe from calamities.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wearing an Aqiq ring according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the wearing of an Aqiq (cornelian) ring to divine blessing (barakah) and protection from calamities (balā'), reflecting the Shia tradition of valuing specific stones for their spiritual and physical benefits. This practice is often contextualized within the broader Islamic emphasis on modest adornment and the symbolic significance of the Prophet's seal ring, which was also made of Aqiq, thereby connecting the believer to prophetic legacy and spiritual security.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that Amirul Momineen (a.s.) said, “
Keep a cornelian ring in your hand  so  that  Allah  gives  you  abundance  and  you  remain safe from calamities.”
